Note: Surfaced by fixing #1766 (test methods now execute in AL source declaration order instead of the AL compiler's alphabetized MethodDef order). This test only ever passed by accident: the old alphabetized order happened to run Database_Commit_AfterInsert_PersistsData (which writes a row) before it, satisfying its own comment's assumption that Cleanup.Initialize() performs a write. In true declaration order nothing has been written yet, so IsInWriteTransaction() reads false. #1791 tracks modelling the administrative write real BC's test harness performs on test entry, which ALDatabasePatches.cs's own faithfulness-boundary comment already says the runner does not reproduce.
